title: [Bug] ttnn.softplus (float32) returns +/-inf, NaN and values up to 3.28e38 for beta*x below -8.72e6, where the exact result is 0
body:
### Describe the bug

`ttnn.softplus(x, beta, threshold)` in `float32` returns `+inf`, `NaN` and finite values as large as
`3.28e38` once `beta * x` falls below about `-8.72e6`, where the exact result has long since
underflowed to exactly `0`. `ttnn.softplus(-1e7)` is `+inf`; `ttnn.softplus(-8.78182e6)` is
`0.715743`. About **8.4 million float32 bit patterns** — essentially all of the binade
`-[2^23, 2^24)` and 4% of `-[2^24, 2^25)` — are affected at `beta = 1`, and the band scales as
`1/beta`.

The tail of the FP32 residual is evaluated by `softplus_exp_negative`
([`ckernel_sfpu_softplus.h#L60-L90`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/blob/main/tt_metal/hw/ckernels/blackhole/metal/llk_api/llk_sfpu/ckernel_sfpu_softplus.h#L60-L90),
the Wormhole copy is byte-identical), which computes `z = -a * INV_LN2` and passes it **unclamped**
to `_sfpu_round_to_nearest_int32_`
([`ckernel_sfpu_exp.h#L299`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/blob/main/tt_metal/hw/ckernels/blackhole/metal/llk_api/llk_sfpu/ckernel_sfpu_exp.h#L299)).
That helper is the Hacker's-Delight round-to-nearest trick and its magic constant
`c231 = 0x4B400000` (`2^23 + 2^22`) is only valid while `z + c231` stays inside `c231`'s own binade,
i.e. `|z| <= 2^22`. Once `z < -c231` the `as<vInt>(tmp) - as<vInt>(c231)` difference comes back a
large **positive** integer, and

```cpp
sfpi::vInt new_exp = p_exp + k_int;
sfpi::vFloat result = 0.0f;
v_if(new_exp > 0) { result = sfpi::setexp(poly, new_exp); }
v_endif;
```

writes it straight into the 8-bit exponent field. The `new_exp > 0` flush-to-zero guard is useless
here precisely because `k_int` has the wrong sign.

Every other caller of the same helper bounds its argument; `softplus` is the one that does not:

| caller | guard |
|---|---|
| [`ckernel_sfpu_xielu.h#L25`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/blob/main/tt_metal/hw/ckernels/blackhole/metal/llk_api/llk_sfpu/ckernel_sfpu_xielu.h#L25) | `z = sfpi::max(z, -126.5f)` — added as the fix for #54046 |
| `ckernel_sfpu_unary_power.h#L161,L201` | `z = sfpi::max(z, -0x7e.ffff8p0f)` plus `v_if(z >= 128) result = inf` |
| `ckernel_sfpu_binary_pow.h#L242,L258` | the same clamp and an explicit exponent bound |
| `ckernel_sfpu_gelu.h` | only reached on the bounded `(-13.375, -5]` branch |
| `ckernel_sfpu_tanh_derivative.h` | only reached below `TAIL_REGION_LIMIT ~ 45` |
| **`ckernel_sfpu_softplus.h#L68`** | **none** |

### Repro

```python
import torch, ttnn

device = ttnn.open_device(device_id=0)
x = torch.tensor([[-8.78182e6, -9.0e6, -1.0e7, -1.2e7, -1.6e7, -1.7432e7]], dtype=torch.float32)
t = ttnn.from_torch(x, dtype=ttnn.float32, layout=ttnn.TILE_LAYOUT, device=device)
print(ttnn.to_torch(ttnn.softplus(t, beta=1.0, threshold=20.0)))
# tensor([[7.1574e-01, 1.6779e-10,        inf, 2.3656e-27,        inf, 5.5537e-38]])
print(torch.nn.functional.softplus(x, beta=1.0, threshold=20.0))
# tensor([[0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0.]])
```

### Observed vs expected (float32, `beta=1`, `threshold=20`)

The exact `softplus` is `0` for every row, so the ULP column is the sign-magnitude distance from
`0.0` to the returned value.

| input | input bits | got | got bits | want | ULP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| -8781820 | `0xCB05FFFC` | 0.715743 | `0x3F373AEF` | 0 | 1,060,584,175 |
| -8767488 | `0xCB05C800` | +inf | `0x7F800000` | 0 | 2,139,095,040 |
| -8768512 | `0xCB05CC00` | NaN | — | 0 | — |
| -9000000 | `0xCB095440` | 1.67788e-10 | `0x2F387C20` | 0 | 792,230,944 |
| -1.0e7 | `0xCB189680` | +inf | `0x7F800000` | 0 | 2,139,095,040 |
| -1.2e7 | `0xCB371B00` | 2.365619e-27 | `0x133B6C76` | 0 | 322,661,494 |
| -12336128 | `0xCB3C3C00` | 3.28091949e+38 | `0x7F76D436` | 0 | 2,138,494,006 |
| -1.6e7 | `0xCB742400` | +inf | `0x7F800000` | 0 | 2,139,095,040 |
| -1.7432e7 | `0xCB84FEE0` | 5.553699e-38 | `0x01972FA2` | 0 | 26,685,346 |

Sweeping all 65,536 bfloat16 bit patterns promoted to `float32`, counting only inputs whose exact
`softplus` underflows to `0`:

| beta | nonzero where the answer is 0 | of which `inf` | band in `x` | max finite \|got\| |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 128 | 44 | [-1.74326e7, -8.78182e6] | 4.566e37 |
| 0.5 | 128 | 44 | [-3.48652e7, -1.75636e7] | 9.132e37 |
| 2 | 128 | 44 | [-8.71629e6, -4.39091e6] | 2.283e37 |
| 10 | 126 | 46 | [-1.7367e6, -872448] | 6.928e34 |
| 100 | 125 | 44 | [-174080, -87552] | 4.560e33 |

The band is exactly `beta * x` below `-c231 * ln(2) = -8.72e6`, so it moves with `1/beta` but never
goes away. A dense per-binade `float32` scan (8,192 mantissa samples per binade, `beta = 1`):

| x | nonzero | inf | NaN | max \|got\| |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| -[2^22, 2^23) | 0 / 8192 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| **-[2^23, 2^24)** | **7,856 / 8,192** | 2,625 | 62 | **3.28092e38** |
| **-[2^24, 2^25)** | 326 / 8,192 | 109 | 2 | 6.11954e37 |
| -[2^25, 2^30) | 0 / 8192 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

### Affected range

`beta * x` in roughly `[-3.4e7, -8.72e6]`, i.e. about 8.4 million float32 bit patterns at
`beta = 1`. `float32` only: the bfloat16 branch clamps its residual to `0` past
`SOFTPLUS_POLY_BOUNDARY` and never reaches the exp tail (that clamp is the subject of #51866).

### Expected behavior

`softplus(x)` tends to `exp(beta * x) / beta`, which is below the smallest normal float long before
`beta * x = -8.7e6`, so the kernel must return exactly `0` there — as it already does for
`beta * x < -3.4e7` and as `torch.nn.functional.softplus` does everywhere.

### Which architectures

Both Wormhole and Blackhole. `tt_metal/hw/ckernels/{wormhole_b0,blackhole}/metal/llk_api/llk_sfpu/ckernel_sfpu_softplus.h`
are byte-identical, so both carry the defect.

### Why the existing tests miss it

`run_activation_softplus_test`
([`test_activation.py#L171-L187`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/blob/main/tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/eltwise/test_activation.py#L171-L187))
builds its stimulus with `torch.rand((h, w), dtype=torch.bfloat16)` — bfloat16 only, inputs in
`[0, 1)`, checked with PCC 0.99. `test_softplus_threshold_boundary` uses thresholds of 4 or below,
and `test_eltwise_softplus_inf.py` samples `uniform_(-100, 100)` in bfloat16. Nothing in the suite
feeds a large negative float32 input.

### How it was verified

ttsim Blackhole v1.10.6 (`TT_METAL_SIMULATOR=libttsim_bh.so`, slow dispatch), exhaustive bfloat16
bit-pattern sweep promoted to `float32` at `beta` = 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 10 / 100, plus a dense
per-binade `float32` scan of `-[2^21, 2^30)` at 8,192 mantissa samples per binade. The golden is
`torch.nn.functional.softplus` evaluated in `float64`, with results below `2^-126` flushed to zero
on both sides.
